baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose construction joins recompense to those who trust and intentionally do the salihat.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settled assent becomes intended action against فساد, and act-correspondent recompense answers that combined posture.

activation_trace.role: Act-for-act return supplies the answering movement of recompense.
Assent in which the heart rests supplies the inward posture that action carries outward.
Intentional doing makes the input enacted rather than merely professed.
صلاح as the contrary of corruption gives the deeds their reparative direction.

changed_reading.before: Believers who do good receive a reward.
changed_reading.after: The stated purpose is an answering return: settled trust becomes intentional repair, and that enacted posture is met correspondingly.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ presents a paired result assigned to them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The outcome has a defensive and a positive operation: harmful residue is covered and its bearer protected, then an apportioned benefit arrives in an honoring mode.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering supplies the defensive shape of the first gift.
Covering fault and shielding its bearer from effect specifies that protection as forgiveness.
A measured allotment supplies the positive share assigned to the recipients.
Commended honor and generosity qualify how the allotted provision is given.

changed_reading.before: They are forgiven and receive good provision.
changed_reading.after: Their return is not mere cancellation: exposure is covered and warded off, then a positively apportioned benefit reaches them with honor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The combination of يَجْزِيَ, عمل, لَهُم, and رزق permits an account-settlement register.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recompense can satisfy or settle what stands against a person, while intentional work has a wage and provision can be a worker's allotment; forgiveness clears liability and provision supplies the positive balance.

activation_trace.role: Something standing in for and sufficing another supplies a satisfaction-of-account register.
Debt collection and full settlement sharpen recompense into account resolution.
The wage or livelihood of work connects deed to compensating return.
A worker-like fixed allotment gives provision an institutional payment register.

changed_reading.before: Reward is an unspecified favor added after good conduct.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also sound like a settled account: forgiveness clears exposure and a fitting allotment answers intentional work, without reducing the result to a commercial bargain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding inventory of every inward, outward, descending, and ascending movement, followed by the atom-weight that cannot escape and the record that fixes judgment, turns recompense into exhaustive resolution rather than a coarse verdict.

activation_trace.role: Act-correspondent return is the focus operation made exact by the preceding audit.
Disclosure to the knower supplies complete epistemic access to the accounted field.
Entry into an interior supplies one direction of otherwise hidden movement.
Passage out of an interior supplies the counter-direction, closing an ingress-egress pair.
Descent and arrival extend the inventory vertically downward.
Ascent upward completes the vertical movement pair.
Distance, absence, and escape are explicitly negated, blocking loss from the account.
Measured weight supplies the audit's fine-grained scale.
The minuteness and dispersal of ذر make even scattered particulars resolvable.
Inscription that fixes a judgment or measure gives the particulars a determinate record.

structural_cues: 34:2 enumerates paired movements immediately before 34:3 denies any escape at every scale.
34:3 places smaller and larger alike in a clear book.
The purpose lām in 34:4 makes recompense the stated outcome of the Hour asserted in 34:3.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive motion, non-escape, minute weight, and fixed record; I infer that these are the informational apparatus of recompense. A live alternative is that they establish omniscience generally without specifying the texture of each reward.

changed_reading.before: Recompense broadly distinguishes good from bad.
changed_reading.after: Recompense resolves every intentional act at microscopic precision; forgiveness is therefore a knowing protective decision, not omission or failed detection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gifted excess softens hard iron; commanded work turns it into full-covering forms whose linked parts must be measured, and the same passage names such work صالح. This materially instantiates صالحات as fitted protective making and activates the covering image inside مغفرة.

activation_trace.role: A cover that protects anchors the focus outcome to the armor analogy.
Gift and benefaction supply the enabling material before the commanded work.
Softness opposed to hardness makes resistant material workable.
Iron and resistant hardness supply the raw medium transformed by work.
Repeated intentional making binds manufacture directly to the focus category of action.
Amplitude that fully covers supplies the protective form of the product.
A measure that brings each part to its limit supplies technical fit.
Piercing and linking rings supplies continuous protective assembly.
The anti-corruptive quality explicitly classifies the commanded making as صالح.

structural_cues: 34:10 moves from bestowed فضل to softened iron.
34:11 moves from material to command, full coverage, measure, linked assembly, and then repeats عمل with صالح.
The repetition of عمل makes craftsmanship rather than possession the operative response to the gift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enabling gift, softened iron, measured linked covering, and the label صالح; I infer an analogy from crafted protection to مغفرة's protective covering. The live alternative is that the armor scene specifies صالح action only, while forgiveness remains unconnected imagery.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds are an abstract moral category followed by abstract forgiveness.
changed_reading.after: Good action can be read as measured, continuous, protective craftsmanship: received capacity is worked into fitting repair, and forgiveness answers it as a shielding cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: In Saba, edible provision, grateful response, good habitat, and a forgiving Lord form one system; turning away is followed by flood, replacement gardens, degraded yield, and explicit recompense. The focus pair of forgiveness and generous provision thus becomes an ecological-social relation, not only a detached award.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned benefit anchors the focus promise to the narrative's supplied share.
Food entering and sustaining the body materializes provision as garden yield.
Recognition of benefit and praise of its giver supplies the demanded social response to provision.
A bounded inhabited land makes provision a property of a lived environment.
Goodness opposed to corruption qualifies the habitat that bears the provision.
Forgiveness paired with the good land repeats the focus's protective divine outcome inside the ecology.
Flood-flow supplies the mechanism that overturns the provision system.
One thing standing in place of another supplies the reversal from gardens to substitute gardens.
Tree and crop yield makes the degraded replacement visible at the level of food output.
Explicit act-correspondent recompense names the narrative reversal as return.

structural_cues: 34:15 coordinates eating, provision, gratitude, good land, and forgiveness.
34:16 reverses the garden system through flood and replacement yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a provision-gratitude pairing and a narrated reversal explicitly named recompense; I infer a functional feedback relation between received ecology and enacted response. A live alternative is that Saba is one judgment example and does not make every promised provision ecological.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and provision are rewards external to the believers' lived world.
changed_reading.after: They can be read as a restored provision ecology: sustaining yield, grateful use, a sound habitat, and protective forgiveness cohere, while corrupt response can return as degraded conditions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah denies that accumulated wealth creates nearness, repeats the focus formula with doubled recompense and secure rooms, and then depicts provision as expanded, constricted, spent outward, and replaced. كريم therefore concerns honoring circulation and secure reception rather than status stock.

activation_trace.role: Honor and generosity anchor the quality of provision independently of sheer quantity.
Accumulated wealth supplies the status claim that the following sequence overturns.
Expansion and abundance make provision variable rather than a fixed badge of favor.
The apportioned gift is the thing sovereignly expanded.
Constriction to a narrow measure supplies the counter-movement to expansion.
Court-like nearness identifies the value that wealth is denied power to purchase.
Security links the faithful input to the secure condition of the resulting rooms.
Act-correspondent return repeats the focus mechanism while detaching it from wealth status.
Increase by another like amount gives the return a multiplying rather than hoarding motion.
Upper rooms materialize provision as secure habitation.
Money going outward in expenditure supplies the release phase of circulation.
A resource returning after prior loss supplies replenishment after expenditure.

structural_cues: 34:35 treats wealth and children as presumed immunity.
34:36 answers with expansion and constriction of provision.
34:37 repeats faith, صالح action, recompense, and security while denying wealth-based nearness.
34:39 converts provision into an outflow-and-replacement sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies status accumulation, metering, the repeated focus formula, secure rooms, expenditure, and replacement; I infer that الكريم quality lies partly in non-status circulation and secure use. A live alternative is that replacement is broader than material return and should not be rendered as guaranteed arithmetic profit.

changed_reading.before: Generous provision means a large stock possessed by favored people.
changed_reading.after: Generous provision is not a status hoard: it is sovereignly metered, can move outward through action, is replenished in a non-arithmetic sense, and culminates in secure reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch in which one thing stands in for another is sharply bounded by the denial of independent ownership, partnership, backing, and useful intercession; separate questioning about acquired wrong and performed work preserves personal attachment of the account.

activation_trace.role: Standing in and sufficing supplies the substitution hypothesis that context tests and limits.
Ownership and power of disposal are negated for proposed brokers.
Partnership is negated, blocking a shared claim over the account.
Strength through a backer or helper is negated, removing independent support.
Benefit opposed to harm is denied to intercession except under the stated permission.
A mediator joining another supplies the precise form of substitution made permission-bound.
Reciprocal questioning is separated across the two parties rather than pooled.
Offense and culpable acquisition identify one side's own account.
Intentional action identifies the other side's own accountable input.

structural_cues: 34:22 stacks four negations: possession, share, and supporting helper among them.
34:25 distributes questioning according to each party's own acquisition or action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied brokerage, a permission exception, and separately attached acts; I infer that the focus account is non-transferable by independent agents. The live alternative is limited mediation by permission, so the context constrains rather than abolishes every standing-in image.

changed_reading.before: The standing-in branch of جزاء may suggest that another agent can independently satisfy or broker the result.
changed_reading.after: Recompense remains attached to the actors and their work; no partner or backer controls it, and any mediating addition is derivative and permission-bound.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing scene places a declaration of faith after seizure, when access has been missed and a barrier now blocks desired reach. This makes the focus's faith temporally active trust capable of becoming work before compelled disclosure, not bare assent whenever uttered.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settled assent anchors the focus category whose timing the closing scene revises.
Missed attainment and failed reach mark the closure of actionable access.
Capture and seizure supply the event after which the declaration is no longer free action.
The same assent image appears explicitly, but now after the decisive event.
Reaching by extension supplies the attempted access that distance makes impossible.
An intervening barrier makes the loss of access spatially explicit.
The soul's pull toward what it wants identifies the desired result now blocked.
Agitated doubt names the earlier posture that prevented timely trust.

structural_cues: 34:51 orders fear, no escape, and seizure before the declaration in 34:52.
34:52 juxtaposes asserted faith with inaccessible reaching from a distant place.
34:54 closes with a barrier between people and what they desire after prior doubt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a late faith claim, failed reach, and a final barrier; I infer that timeliness and freedom-to-act are dimensions of the focus's faith-work pair. A live alternative is that the scene concerns eschatological opportunity without changing the lexical content of آمنوا.

changed_reading.before: Faith is assent whose timing and relation to action remain unspecified.
changed_reading.after: Faith here is timely, heart-settled trust while response is still reachable, evidenced by its capacity to become صالح action before disclosure compels acknowledgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's split mapping from ج ز ي to the form-distant ج ز ز branch of maturity and cutting. It remains anchored in يَجْزِيَ and is activated by Saba's replaced crop yield and explicit جزاء; downstream prose should label it a harvest overlay, not the lexical gloss of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَجْزِيَ is explicitly supplied with a secondary ج ز ز inventory, while رزق كريم supplies rain, fertile growth, and noble yield images.

activation_trace.role: Maturity reaching the time of cutting supplies an exploratory harvest shape for recompense.
Rain descending as provision supplies the input that makes a harvest possible.
Good soil, plant growth, and rain make كريم provision agriculturally productive.
Crop and tree yield supplies the altered harvest produced by the replacement gardens.
One crop-system standing in place of another gives the harvest image a reversible outcome.
Explicit act-correspondent return anchors the preceding changed yield back to recompense.

changed_reading.before: Reward is delivered after deeds as an unrelated payment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, deeds ripen toward a cutting point and are gathered as apportioned yield; the Saba reversal shows that corrupted response can likewise return as a changed harvest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines worker-wage, military-allotment, debt-settlement, and prophetic-fee registers. All are packet branches anchored in عمل, رزق, and جزاء, and 34:47 relocates أجر away from extraction from the audience; downstream prose should call this an institutional analogy, not claim a literal employment contract or a debt owed by God.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عمل, يَجْزِيَ, and رزق can jointly sound in a compensation register, while 34:47 distinguishes divine أجر from a fee taken from hearers.

activation_trace.role: Full collection and settlement supply the resolved-account side of compensation.
Work's wage and worker's livelihood supply a labor-compensation register.
An assigned stipend supplies an institutional allotment rather than random bounty.
Payment for work is denied as an audience charge and located with God, containing the compensation analogy.

changed_reading.before: The focus reward is either a free gift or a commercial payment from beneficiaries.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a divinely settled worker-allotment that answers labor but is not extracted as a fee from those addressed.

strongest_changes: The pre-focus motion inventory and atom-scale record sharpen جزاء into exhaustive, deliberate accounting.
David's measured linked covering makes صالح action materially constructive and activates forgiveness as protective cover.
Saba turns forgiveness and provision into a provision-gratitude ecology whose reversal is explicitly called recompense.
The wealth sequence recasts generous provision as non-status circulation, secure use, and non-arithmetic replenishment.
The closing failed reach makes faith timely trust that must become action before compelled disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly materialized the compact focus formula: in armor, gardens, travel and wealth systems, account records, social brokerage limits, and the timing of access. Those mechanisms changed the verse more than broad thematic parallels did.
remaining_uncertainties: The armor-to-forgiveness link is a reader-supplied material analogy rather than an explicit identification.
The harvest reading depends on a deliberately form-distant split-root branch and should remain exploratory.
Provision may name promised eschatological benefit more narrowly than the worldly ecological and circulatory activations suggest.
Permission-dependent intercession prevents the anti-brokerage model from becoming an absolute denial of all mediation.
